regime_context: Detector shows a narrowing leadership rotation (45% eligible, 22 of 49 themes) with AI Infrastructure (SMH proxy, score 1.56) leading US Energy Complex (XLE, 1.375) by a thin 0.185 margin. Momentum rank is a focus lens (~0 rank-IC), and the only validated edge here is trend-gate drawdown control (gate_helps true), so this note calibrates modestly around durability and structure rather than predicted returns.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the challenger (US Energy Complex) confirms a handoff: if XLE closes above SMH on a rolling 20-day relative basis while AI Infrastructure breadth stays at or below 0.125, retire the watch and treat Energy as the confirmed leader.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate remains eligible, but durability is weak (bar 0.5, current 0.5, hurst mixed, breadth only 0.125), which argues for restraint rather than scale. Leadership is real but thin and narrowly held — a staying-power leg, not a confirmation of follow-through.
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.125 with mixed trend health means participation is extremely thin — the theme can lead on a handful of mega-cap names while the underlying cohort rolls over, a classic late-cycle leadership trap.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days before the 30-day check-by.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Challenger with substantially better durability and breadth than the leader (bar 0.62 vs 0.50, breadth 0.636 vs 0.125) and healthy, uncrowded texture. The trend-gate eligibility combined with strong participation makes this a more robust stay-the-course candidate than the headline leader.
theses.dissent: Energy is a high-beta, oil-price-sensitive complex; if crude breaks down coincident with an AI-led equity melt-up, the relative tail underperforms sharply despite good internal breadth.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more over any rolling 20-day window before the 30-day check-by.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank 3 and trend-eligible, but the crowding flag (z 1.61, crowded true) is a size-down caution — never a fade. With durability near its ceiling (0.75) and elevated crowding, the reward/risk for adding fresh exposure here is poor relative to less-crowded challengers.
theses.dissent: Crowding is coincident and has no basket-level forward edge per the backtest verdict — by itself it says nothing about direction, so avoiding a well-trending, high-durability theme could simply mean missing continued strength.

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a new 60-day high and holds above it for 10 consecutive sessions before the 20-day check-by.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
